## Data Science + Economics | Rutgers Baseball Analytics

I build baseball analytics tools and research projects focused on player evaluation, pitcher development, and decision-making using R, econometrics, and TrackMan data.

## Areas of Focus:

- Pitcher development
- Econometrics
- Salary arbitration research
- TrackMan analytics
- Player evaluation
